title: Flock Event Logs Vacaville CA PD

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting a copy of the following record related to your agency's use of Flock Safety surveillance systems (including automated license plate reader, or "ALPR," cameras):

Event Logs (full history)

Specifically, I am requesting the complete Flock "Event Logs" for your agency's account, covering its full history — from the date your agency's Flock Safety account was activated through the date of this request. This record documents administrative actions inside the account: granting or changing network sharing, adding users and roles, renaming cameras, and opening live camera streams. Please include all available fields: Timestamp, User, Event Type (create/update/delete), Entity Type, Entity Details, and Event ID. I have attached a screenshot from a Flock presentation on how the admin can access this.

If the full history exceeds a size or date range your export tool can produce in a single file, please produce it in sequential increments (e.g., the 31-day increments Flock's own export tool uses) rather than truncating or limiting the record to a shorter period.

This record can be exported from the Flock software's "Insights" section as a CSV file. Per Flock Safety's own "Guide to Flock Safety Data for Open Records Laws" (Sept. 3, 2025): "The audit logs can be accessed via your agency's Flock admin dashboard on the 'Insights' tab.... Customers may download these logs in the user interface as spreadsheets in 31-day increments. It is recommended that Flock customer support assist customers with the downloads when feasible for timeframes larger than six months and major accounts." (Flock Safety, Guide to Flock Safety Data for Open Records Laws, Sept. 3, 2025.) Please provide the record in its original electronic format (CSV or Excel) where possible.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All historical copies of any agreement, memorandum of understanding, contract, amendment, statement of work, or addendum — regardless of title — between the City of Vacaville/Vacaville Police Department and Flock Safety, Inc. (or any Flock subsidiary, affiliate, or reseller) that represents any  sort of demo, testing, or development partnership agreement.

This includes but is not limited to any agreement characterized as a development partnership, product testing or beta agreement, pilot program, “ambassador” or reference-customer arrangement, sales demonstration or sales-support agreement, co-marketing agreement, or discounted/free/trial deployment of any kind.

Please identify the date and agenda item number, if any, on which the Vacaville City Council voted to approve, amend, or ratify any agreement with Flock Safety, Inc. authorizing access to view livestreams and make videos of its video cameras, not limited to the VMS. If no such vote occurred, please state so.

For context, Flock Chief Legal Officer Dan Haley recently testified under oath that sharing camera access "would be a choice made be elected officials in that community" and that access to cameras "depends on the nature of the development partnership and what access has been explicitly granted by the community for what purpose"

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any and all records of correspondence between any representatives of the Williams Companies and Tim Davis, Bryce Bird, Ashley Davis, and Nathan Lunstad and their staff between January 1, 2024 and the date this request is processed.

Records sought include:

- Correspondence: Emails, text messages, letters, messaging applications, and other written or electronic communications. This request includes communications sent to or received by personal devices or accounts when used to conduct public business.
- Meetings and calls: All records concerning meetings, telephone calls, video conferences, or other discussions between DEQ employees and Williams representatives, including calendar invitations, calendar entries, meeting requests, scheduling communications, attendee lists, agendas, notes, minutes, recordings, and follow-up correspondence.
- Meeting materials and presentations: All documents, presentations, briefing materials, talking points, memoranda, reports, handouts, slide decks, data, maps, and other materials prepared for, provided during, exchanged at, or circulated in connection with meetings or discussions involving Williams and DEQ employees.
- Internal communications: All internal DEQ discussions pertaining to Williams, its projects, facilities, operations, applications, permits, regulatory compliance, or other matters involving the company, including communications concerning planned or completed meetings with company representatives.
- Third-party communications: All communications between DEQ and any third party, including consultants, attorneys, trade associations, other government agencies, or contractors, concerning Williams or its projects.

In order to help to determine my status to assess fees, you should know that I am a journalist for WIRED magazine. Disclosure of the requested information to me is in the public interest because it is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding of the operations or activities of the government and is not primarily in my commercial interest.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Molly Taft
